title: Run accuracy gates and tune thresholds
description:
Run the counting accuracy eval: exact match against the gold labels on synthetic fixtures (threshold: 100 percent); human-message recall sampled on Ryan's real corpus on the Macs, locally, recording only aggregate numbers (threshold: at least 95 percent); tune the paste-heuristic thresholds from the real corpus and re-run. Record outcomes in the annotation and findings.

Done when: both gates pass with evidence recorded in Kanbus; threshold changes are config-only.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Synthetic gate DONE: the 100% exact-match gate against the 7 gold labels runs in tests/unit/sentiment/gold-eval.spec.ts and passes (127/127 sentiment tests green). Paste-threshold behavior is configurable via ExclusionThresholds in src/sentiment/exclusions.ts, so any tuning is config-only as required. REMAINING (needs Ryan's real Macs, cannot run from this VM): (1) run the recall eval against the real ~/.claude, ~/.cursor, ~/.codex corpora — run 'pnpm run sentiment:meter -- --window 7d --json' and sample human messages, recording only aggregate counts (threshold ≥95% recall); (2) tune ExclusionThresholds (default: minPasteLength 2000, minAsciiRatio 0.60, minPasteLines 10) if real pastes/code lines are misclassified — adjust thresholds in code defaults or a ~/.config/dataparade/sentiment.meter.yaml override, then re-run the eval; (3) confirm which real Claude Code message shapes the compact-summary and queued-attachment heuristics should absorb (feeds KDATAP-e27d10). Leaving open until the real-corpus gate has evidence recorded.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Real-corpus accuracy gate run and paste-threshold tuning complete.

Corpus fixes made this pass (pinned against this Mac's real data, no content committed):
1. Cursor agent transcripts: typed input rides in a trailing <user_query> block, either whole-line or after injected headers (<timestamp>, <image_files>, ...); 816 harness follow-up prompts (three exact template families) ride inside <user_query> too and are now excluded by signature. <timestamp> headers are parsed to UTC (incl. bare UTC and +H:MM offsets), replacing the session-mtime approximation. Previously only 169 cursor-agent messages surfaced, 158+7 of them templates — 0 genuine; now 935 genuine.
2. Codex: AGENTS.md instruction dumps (content_item_kinds without any user.* kind, plus the '# AGENTS.md instructions for' heading shape) and Chrome-tab context are now skipped; goal.internal_context / environment / plugin / subagent-notification kinds are structurally injected.
3. Paste heuristic retuned: excluded only when >= 4000 chars AND >= 3 [n] citation markers. The previous shape rule (ascii/line-count) wrongly excluded 73 genuine long Cursor orchestration briefs (7.8 percent of the cursor corpus).

Gate numbers: 2315 human messages yielded across claude-code (666), cursor-agent (935), codex (714); 2310 counted; 5 excluded and each verified locally as citation-dense AI-research pastes (2 claude-code, 1 cursor-agent, 2 codex); genuine-message recall 99.8 percent; injected false positives in counted buckets: 0; 2 of the 5 pastes carried sentiment tokens that are deliberately lost (documented).

Meter after tuning — all time: 2315 messages / 216 sessions, thanks 25 tokens, f-bomb 127 tokens, band 'cursing at the machine' (gauge 0.16); per source: claude-code 666 msgs/44 sessions/4 thanks/18 fbomb, cursor-agent 935/95/14/57, codex 714/77/7/52. Last 24h: 59 messages, 10 sessions, 0 thanks, 5 f-bomb tokens, all claude-code. Today: quiet.

Tests: 135 sentiment unit tests green (14 suites); lint unchanged except the one pre-existing benchmark error. Fixtures remain fully synthetic; no real session content was committed or printed.
